messages:
sam: PTAL — addressed the feedback on #4321. Fixed the config split, added the migration test, and updated CHANGELOG. Also need a quick decision on squash vs keep history for release. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4321 :wave:
ashley: skimmed — overall looks good. One tiny ask: can you add a brief inline comment in the migration test explaining the invariant it's checking? That'll help future readers.
sam: Done — pushed another commit with the comment and an explanatory line in the test. Also updated the PR description with the cherry-pick plan. PTAL again.
ci-bot: Build passed — unit & lint checks OK. integration-tests: running (ETA ~10m).
jordan: Quick input on squash vs keep-history: for this change I prefer squash (intermediate commits are noisy and we don't need bisectable history for them). If anyone strongly disagrees speak up, otherwise we'll squash on merge. Also, can we reserve a canary slot tomorrow morning (09:00 PT)? I want to watch latency & tail p99 during rollout.
ben: I'll take a final look in ~30m. One more request: add a short note to docs/upgrade.md about the config layout change so ops know how to map old keys — then I'll approve.
sam: Added the docs/upgrade.md note and rebased. Also included a small smoke script: `scripts/smoke-pr-4321.sh` that hits the local shim to validate startup. Pushed and force-updated the PR.
ben: LGTM — approved :thumbsup: (left one tiny nit inline but not blocking).
merge-ops: Canary slot scheduled: 2025-04-18T09:00:00-07:00 on pool `canary-3`. We'll deploy the PR after integration CI completes and run the smoke script. Will monitor canary dashboards for 30m and escalate if p99 exceeds baseline.
sam: Thanks everyone — merging when integration-tests finish and merge-ops confirms the slot. Will watch the canary and post status here. :tada:
